purpose: Make ERN monetization truth explicit: distinguish research coverage from links that can actually earn affiliate commission.
earningRule: ERN can earn only when a visitor follows a valid tracked affiliate link (or other approved tracked affiliate surface) and completes an eligible transaction under that partner's attribution and commission rules.

states.RESEARCH_ONLY: Program/destination looks useful, but no owner-approved tracked link exists. Clicks should not be treated as revenue-producing.
states.ACCOUNT_AVAILABLE: Owner account/program can generate links, but the exact destination link still needs generation and verification.
states.TRACKED_LINK_VERIFIED: Exact tracked link has been generated and manually verified. It may be revenue-producing when publicly placed with disclosure.
states.PUBLIC_REVENUE_ACTIVE: Tracked link is actually exposed to visitors in an approved ERN commercial surface. Eligible attributed purchases can earn commission.
states.REJECTED_OR_UNAVAILABLE: Do not place or imply an active commercial relationship.
